visa_options.eligibility_us: YES — United States is one of the 55+ eligible countries under China NIA's 240h transit policy (even though the US is NOT on the 30-day unilateral visa-free list).
visa_options.routing_rule: STRICTLY requires Country/Region A → Mainland China → Country/Region C (e.g., SFO → PVG, then PVG/SHA → Tokyo, Seoul, Hong Kong, Taipei, or Singapore → SFO). Direct US → Shanghai → US round-trip is INELIGIBLE.
visa_options.max_stay: Up to 240 hours (10 full days starting 00:00 the day after arrival) across Shanghai & 24 permitted provinces (includes Jiangsu/Suzhou & Zhejiang/Hangzhou!).
visa_options.documents_needed: US passport valid ≥3 months + confirmed interline/onward seat ticket to 3rd country/region + hotel reservation.

visa_options.pathway: Pathway 2 · Simplified US Citizen Tourist Visa (L-Visa via New COVA)
visa_options.eligibility_us: Required for direct US ↔ Mainland China round-trip flights OR stays >10 days (14–28 night options).
visa_options.routing_rule: Allows any routing (direct US ↔ PVG round-trip) and multi-year multiple entries (US citizens typically eligible for 10-year multi-entry L-visa).
visa_options.max_stay: Typically 60–90 days per entry (covers 1–4 week trip easily).
visa_options.cost_for_couple: $280 USD for 2 ($140/person Regular Fee reduced through Dec 31, 2026; reverts to $185/pp = $370/2 if unextended after Dec 31, 2026; Express +$25/pp).
visa_options.documents_needed: SIMPLIFIED FOR US APPLICANTS: Since Jan 1, 2024 (reconfirmed Sep 20, 2025 for the upgraded COVA portal consular.mfa.gov.cn/VISA/), US tourist L-visa applicants do NOT need air tickets, hotel bookings, itinerary, or invitation letters! Submit online first (1–2 week preliminary review), then drop passport at Consular Office.

questions.question: Will you fly round-trip US ↔ Shanghai, or route onward via a 3rd country/region (e.g., Tokyo, Seoul, Hong Kong, or Taipei)?
questions.why_it_matters: Determines whether you qualify for $0 240-hour Visa-Free Transit (≤10 days) or need a $140/pp ($280/couple) Chinese L-Visa before Dec 31, 2026.
questions.discovery_method: Compare Google Flights / airline multi-city 'US → PVG, PVG → HND/ICN/HKG → US' fares against direct 'US ↔ PVG' round-trip + $280 L-visa cost before Dec 15, 2026.

questions.question: Which exact duration do you want: 7 nights (Feb 15–22), 10 nights (Feb 15–25), 14 nights (Feb 15–Mar 1), or 21–28 nights?
questions.why_it_matters: Stays ≤10 days fit 240h visa-free transit; 14 nights captures both low-rate February weeks before March 1's +15%–40% hotel rate jump and unlocks Hangzhou (13★).
questions.discovery_method: Confirm PTO days with employers and check whether 240h transit clock (00:00 day after arrival to scheduled departure) covers your preferred return flight.

questions.question: Do you want to lock The Peninsula Shanghai's 15%-off + breakfast promo (non-refundable, expires Dec 7, 2026) or book a Free-Cancellation base (#1 Langham $2,291.93 w/ breakfast or #4 Sukhothai $2,394.04)?
questions.why_it_matters: Peninsula's 'A Gift for the New Year' offer closes Dec 7, 2026 and requires full prepayment, whereas Langham & Sukhothai allow free cancellation until Feb 14, 2027.
questions.discovery_method: Pull live checkout quote on peninsula.com before Dec 7, 2026 and compare directly against Langham's $2,291.93 refundable MICHELIN quote.

questions.question: Do you prefer 1 shared King/Queen bed or 2 Queen beds in one private room?
questions.why_it_matters: Langham, Andaz, Shangri-La, Sukhothai, and Ritz-Carlton base quotes are 1 King; W Shanghai base ($2,733.53) is 1 Queen ($2,792.31 for 1 King); Shanghai EDITION ($3,222.01) offers 2 Queen beds.
questions.discovery_method: Select exact room code on checkout screen and save confirmation PDF showing bed count and private bathroom.

questions.question: What is your comfortable ceiling per flagship dinner, and should we email Taian Table (3★), 8½ Otto e Mezzo (2★), Fu He Hui (2★), and Ling Long (1★) for Feb 2027 menu tariffs?
questions.why_it_matters: Those 4 starred venues omit base menu totals from public websites (Taian Table takes RMB 2,000/pp deposit).
questions.discovery_method: Email info@taian-table.cn, infosha@ottoemezzobombana.com, and call Fu He Hui (+86 21 3980 9188) 45–60 days before arrival to request current RMB tasting tariffs + service charge.

questions.question: Do either of you have shellfish/seafood allergies, vegetarian preferences, or interest in wine/tea pairings?
questions.why_it_matters: Taian Table's FAQ notes severe dietary substitutions require advance review; Bao Li Xuan's wine pairing adds CNY 1,600/couple; Fu He Hui (2★) is 100% vegetarian.
questions.discovery_method: List allergies in writing at reservation time (≥14 days prior) and request non-alcoholic tea pairing pricing where desired.

questions.question: Do you want T'ang Court (2★) on a mid-week lunch (Wed–Sun) rather than Monday?
questions.why_it_matters: Langham's official T'ang Court page prints both 'daily' and 'Off on Monday'.
questions.discovery_method: Schedule T'ang Court Tue–Sun (we placed it on Wed Feb 17 in the itinerary) or email tlshx.tangcourt@langhamhotels.com to confirm Monday status.

questions.question: If considering #7 Ritz-Carlton Pudong ($2,532.92) or 1★ Jin Xuan, does ongoing lobby/55F spa enhancement work bother you?
questions.why_it_matters: Official Jin Xuan page announces enhancement work in 1F Lobby, 1F Retail, 3F Banquet, and 55F Spa starting Oct 1, 2026 with no published completion date.
questions.discovery_method: Contact Ritz-Carlton Pudong (+86 21 2020 1888) in Jan 2027 to confirm whether 55F Spa & 1F Lobby works will still be active on Feb 15–22, 2027.

questions.category: Day-5 Choice: Disneyland vs Ancient Canal Town
questions.question: On Friday Feb 19, do you prefer Zhujiajiao Ancient Water Town (CNY 120/2) or Shanghai Disneyland (from CNY 950/2)?
questions.why_it_matters: Both sit at the ~50–65 min Metro boundary (Line 17 vs Line 11) and require a dedicated day in a 7-night plan (a 10-night plan easily fits both).
questions.discovery_method: Check Shanghai Disneyland's Feb 2027 opening hours & date-tier price 30 days ahead on shanghaidisneyresort.com/en/.

questions.question: Have both travelers verified passport identity inside Alipay and WeChat Pay with a zero-FX US Visa/Mastercard?
questions.why_it_matters: Shanghai Metro QR codes, Yu Garden mini-program tickets,Museum of Art Pudong tickets, and Taian Table WeChat deposits rely heavily on Alipay/WeChat.
questions.discovery_method: Install Alipay & WeChat in the US 2 weeks pre-trip, complete passport real-name verification, bind 2 no-FTF credit cards each, and install a roaming eSIM (Airalo/Holafly/US carrier) so Western apps & maps work without local firewall blocks.

suggestions.title: Use an Open-Jaw 3rd-Country/Region Ticket to Unlock $0 240-Hour Visa-Free Transit
suggestions.upside: Saves $280 in US L-Visa fees + consular drop-off logistics while adding 1–2 nights in Tokyo, Seoul, Hong Kong, or Taipei.
suggestions.tradeoff: Caps Mainland China stay at 240 hours (10 days) and requires confirmed onward seat before boarding in the US.
suggestions.verification_step: Price multi-city airfare (e.g. SFO → PVG Feb 14/15, PVG → TYO/HKG Feb 22, TYO/HKG → SFO Feb 24) against direct SFO ↔ PVG + $280 L-visa.

suggestions.title: Two-Stage 'Free-Cancel Lock + Feb 1 Re-Price' Hotel Booking Strategy
suggestions.upside: Locking #1 Langham ($2,291.93 w/ breakfast, free cancel Feb 14) or #4 Sukhothai ($2,394.04, free cancel Feb 14) right now eliminates upside price risk while preserving the option to switch to a cheaper last-minute non-refundable rate on Feb 1–7, 2027.
suggestions.tradeoff: Requires setting a calendar reminder before Feb 13, 2027.
suggestions.verification_step: Book refundable rate today; re-run exact dated MICHELIN Hotels & direct brand search on Feb 2, 2027.

suggestions.title: Starred Cantonese Lunch Arbitrage + Selected/3★ Evening Pairing
suggestions.upside: Booking T'ang Court (2★, CNY 888 for 2) and Yi Long Court (1★, CNY 695–788 for 2) at lunchtime cuts per-couple spend by 61%–66% versus their evening tasting menus (CNY 2,288–2,304), freeing budget for 3★ Taian Table at night.
suggestions.tradeoff: Hearty midday dim sum means scheduling lighter walks in the afternoon.
suggestions.verification_step: Request the 'Dim Sum Lunch Set Menu for Two' explicitly when booking T'ang Court & Yi Long Court.

suggestions.title: If Extending to 14 Nights (Feb 15 – Mar 1), Add 3 Nights in Hangzhou via 45-Min HSR
suggestions.upside: Hangzhou adds 13 MICHELIN-starred + 75 Bib/Selected venues around West Lake & Longjing tea hills while keeping your entire 2-week trip inside February's low hotel-rate trough before March 1.
suggestions.tradeoff: Requires a Chinese L-Visa (exceeds 240h transit) or exiting directly from Hangzhou Xiaoshan Airport (HGH, an eligible 240h port!) within 10 days.
suggestions.verification_step: Check 12306.cn G-train schedules (Shanghai Hongqiao → Hangzhou East, 45–55 min) 15 days before travel.

suggestions.title: Buy the CNY 55 'Maglev Single + 24-Hour Metro Pass' Bundle at PVG Arrival
suggestions.upside: Costs only CNY 5 (~$0.70) more than a standalone CNY 50 Maglev ticket and covers unlimited Shanghai Metro rides for your first 24 hours.
suggestions.tradeoff: Sold at PVG Maglev ticket counter rather than direct credit-card tap at turnstile.
suggestions.verification_step: Ask for the Maglev & Metro Pass Joint Ticket (CNY 55) at Pudong Airport Maglev station window.

suggestions.title: Swap Saturday Lantern Festival Yuyuan Crowds for Friday Evening Night Tour + Bund Rooftop
suggestions.upside: Sat Feb 20, 2027 is Lantern Festival — Yuyuan Old Street reaches maximum annual crowd density and often implements one-way pedestrian queues. Visiting Yuyuan Night Tour on Fri Feb 19 (18:00–21:20) and viewing Lantern night from a Bund rooftop on Sat Feb 20 avoids multi-hour crowd control.
suggestions.tradeoff: Misses the exact 15th-lunar-day atmosphere inside Yuyuan Mall.
suggestions.verification_step: Monitor '上海豫园' WeChat notices in early Feb 2027 for Lantern Festival crowd-control hours and surge pricing.
